_doc: Life: what materializes (docs/tracks/life.md). near/keep: a settlement or party appears when a player is within near_tiles (x and y) and folds back past keep_tiles. caps: most actors shown per settlement (guards) and per party. townsfolk: how many people of a settlement are shown, by tier (never more than its civilians). first_roles: the roles of the first shown people by tier; the rest are townsfolk. role_slug: the SRD stat block of a role ('' = the culture's people block); a culture's own roles table (data/sim/cultures.json) comes first; monstrous cultures use their people block for every role their table doesn't name. A culture's first_roles replace these by tier. look_role: the look.people role key per role or stat block. hours: the daily round (work from..to, then the square at dusk, home at night). break: the fraction of its starting strength a side may lose before it gives up a real-time fight (the sim's own numbers). stall_s: a raid handed to real time with no blows for this long goes back to the sim's rules; an ambush with no blows for this long and neither side broken is won by the side holding more of its strength (core/life/life_road.gd).
